title: Cruise Outbreaks Rose Despite Modern Mega-Ships
hook: Cruise outbreaks climbed to 20 in a year.
closing: Bigger ships make hygiene matter more because one illness reaches a much larger crowd.
question: Would an outbreak change your cruise plans?

segments.say: Cruise outbreaks reached 20, showing modern ships have not eliminated gastrointestinal illness.
Norovirus caused 15 outbreaks, making one preventable illness the dominant problem.
The largest cruise ship holds 7,600 guests, giving one contagious passenger an enormous crowd to reach.
